description: This script automates restoration of various database types (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB) based on available backup files and environment conditions.

methods.name: restore_sqlite
methods.description: Copies the SQLite backup file to the database directory.

methods.name: restore_postgresql
methods.description: Uses psql to restore PostgreSQL database if PostgreSQL is available and accessible.

methods.name: restore_mysql
methods.description: Attempts to restore MySQL either via TCP connection or socket, with various credential fallbacks.

methods.name: restore_mongodb
methods.description: Restores MongoDB from an archive backup if MongoDB is available.
